recognize_zh: 高倍下是一片單形的中型細胞，核圓至略不規則、染色質細緻分散如淋巴母細胞、核仁小，並散在多個有絲分裂象與凋亡小體，呈現母細胞型被套細胞淋巴瘤的高增生樣貌。
features: Monotonous sheet of medium-sized lymphoid cells with scant pale cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular or indented nuclei with finely dispersed, blast-like chromatin and small inconspicuous nucleoli
Numerous mitotic figures and scattered apoptotic bodies
Occasional tingible body macrophages with vacuolated cytoplasm, but no well-developed starry-sky pattern
Thin fibrovascular septum with a few larger stromal/endothelial nuclei at right
describe_en: High-power section shows a diffuse, monotonous proliferation of medium-sized lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm, round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli, resembling lymphoblasts. Mitotic figures are numerous, and scattered apoptotic bodies and occasional tingible body macrophages are present. The morphology alone does not establish lineage. Together with CD20 and cyclin D1 positivity and a Ki-67 index above 90%, findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid variant.

ddx.vs: Morphology is essentially indistinguishable; TdT and CD34 expression without cyclin D1 favors lymphoblastic lymphoma.
Cells have multiple small nucleoli, squared-off cytoplasmic borders with lipid vacuoles and a prominent starry-sky pattern, with a CD10+/BCL2-/cyclin D1- phenotype.

ddx.dx: Pleomorphic variant of mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Cells are larger and more heterogeneous with prominent nucleoli, rather than the uniform fine-chromatin blastoid cells seen here.
Blasts often show more eosinophilic cytoplasm and admixed eosinophilic myelocytes, and express MPO/CD117/CD33 instead of CD20 and cyclin D1.
